summary_bullets: Closed inherited blockers are treated as satisfied dependencies instead of permanent close blockers.
Fully stale OOS sources now have an approval-gated close helper instead of raw closure guidance.
Deferred combine output now carries a stable source-to-combined mapping fragment for safer accumulation.
commit_message:
Fix combine-issues closed-blocker closure

Classify closed inherited blockers as satisfied after repo-gated metadata enrichment, keep satisfied edges out of writes and closure blockers, emit deferred source mapping fragments, add close-stale, and update OOS guidance and regression coverage.
